name: harz-pull-sh-one-command-unattended-20261009
description: HARZ pull.sh ONE-COMMAND PULL (Oct 9 2026, owner-approved): single paste runs the whole corpus pull unattended — key saved locally, checksum-verified fetch, wake lock, self-restart on Android kill or offline, auto parity battery at the end. 5/5 death tests incl. kill-mid-run recovery and offline honesty. Worker v0.2.8 (/pull.sh + /files routes, all prior routes regression-verified). Node 1 usage: one command, phone charging.
content:
{
  "change": "HARZ pull.sh v1.1 \u2014 one-command unattended corpus pull (owner-approved 'find another way', 2026-10-09). Single paste does everything: saves key locally, fetches files with sha256 verification (no unzip dependency), holds Termux wake lock, runs export, self-restarts when Android kills the process or network goes offline, runs parity battery automatically on completion. Worker v0.2.8: new routes /pull.sh + /files/{name} + /files/{name}.sha (byte-safe Uint8Array serving), all existing routes untouched.",
  "why": "Owner cannot babysit manual export sessions on Node 1; Android repeatedly killed Termux mid-pull. Standard: one command, zero follow-up steps.",
  "audit_first": "CHECK: export/battery/retry logic already death-tested (rows 100-101). AUDIT: wrapper adds restart loop, key persistence (local file chmod 600, never uploaded), checksum-gated fetch. HIGHLIGHT: pro=survives process kills, offline, Termux refresh with ONE rerun command; con=restarts consume battery, phone must charge. NO DUPLICATES: no unattended runner existed. WAIT: owner instructed ('find another way').",
  "death_tests": "Sandbox, 5 behaviors: (1) no key -> instructions, exit 1; (2) fresh install -> checksum-verified fetch -> full export -> PARITY PASS exit 0; (3) kill -9 export mid-run (simulated Android) -> pull.sh restarts it -> resumes from durable cursor (500) -> interrupted batch deduped (alreadyStored=352) -> completion -> PARITY PASS; (4) permanent offline -> 8 restarts in 25s, zero false DONEs; (5) 401 -> honest stop, zero loop attempts. Live smoke: sandbox run against production correctly 401'd (test key) and stopped honestly.",
  "delivery": "pull.sh sha256 07f3373c...1faa978 (ASCII-clean, bash -n verified, live download byte-identical). /files/export-corpus.js 5152d584, /files/vault.js 44bf06c5, /files/parity-battery.js fc2d81cf \u2014 all byte-identical to served .sha values. Regression: root 200, stats 1055189, export key-gated, vault-v01.zip 1dfb1e52 unchanged, export-kit.zip 109af058 unchanged. Fixed en route: atob mojibake (binary-as-UTF-8) and route slice(8)->slice(7) bug in v0.2.7, corrected in v0.2.8 before Node 1 use.",
  "node1_use": "ONE command in Termux: HARZ_WAVE_KEY=<key> bash <(curl -s https://harz-million-corpus.harz.workers.dev/pull.sh). Key saved locally after first run; future runs: bash <(curl -s .../pull.sh). Phone must stay charging."
}
